This is a starting suggestion. Our team can help confirm a suitable project and level.

Does my child need coding experience?

Starter students can use templates and build the core workflow with mentor guidance. Students with experience can explore an extra feature once the main workflow works.

Will my child build one of these demos?

These projects are examples. Your child chooses their own idea with a mentor and plans a first version that fits six weeks.

How much time should we plan for?

The programme includes two live mentor sessions per week, with 6–8 hours of total work each week across six weeks.
